ask: Main already shrinks Android code. What should I do with my change?
problem: Google Play warns that the Android app's code is not shrunk. The deadline is February 2027.
found: The Expo update on main already turns shrinking on. It also keeps the speech model safe and was tested on an emulator.
changed: Nothing yet. My change clashes with main, so I stopped. People see no difference either way.
why: Two ways to do the same job can clash. Play reads the crash map from the app bundle, so no upload step is needed.
touches: Any option needs a new store build to reach people. I started none.

options.label: Close my change
options.result: I close the pull request. Main covers the Play warning. No more work.

options.label: Keep one small setting
options.result: I rebuild on the new Expo version with only resource shrinking. It needs a phone test.

options.label: Keep my full change
options.result: I merge it with main's rules. Both sets of keep rules stay. It needs a phone test.
